title: 第十五章 朋友位白银盟主江南V神话加第十六章 洛北大学武学院
content_zh:
（感谢江南V神话百万打赏，为天下第九再加一白银盟主）
狄九没有再回原来的住处，不仅仅是那个房子是租来的，还有他现在可不想和狄家的那个狄子恒纠缠不清。狄氏制药，听起来很牛，狄九还真没放在眼里。更何况，他很清楚自己和那狄文成没有任何关系。
再次背着包走在繁华的洛津，狄九满脑子都是现在应该去什么地方？
也不知道走了多久，想了多久，他的脑海中突兀的记忆起一个电话号码，似乎前世他每次需要帮忙的时候，都是拨打这个电话。
电话接通是一个略显疲惫的男声，当对方听到狄九的声音后，立即惊喜叫道，“子默，你在哪里？怎么这一年多我都没有你的消息？”
一个熟悉的名字冒了出来，游狐离，好奇怪的名字。很显然游狐离和狄九的关系非同一般，在电话里面急切的让狄九原地等候后，就急匆匆的挂了电话。
狄九并没有等多久，只是半个小时时间，一辆出租车就停在了他的面前。
车里下来的是一名矮胖的青年，青年长相一般，头发也有些凌乱，脸上带着一种由衷的开心。狄九一看，就知道这青年就是游狐离。
“子默，你这一年去哪里了啊，怎么一个电话都不打给我？”游狐离还没有到面前，就大声叫道。
“我出去散了散心，回来连住的地方都没有了。还有，我改名狄九了。”狄九说道。
“好好的改什么名字啊，走，去我住的地方，地方大的很。”游孤根本就没有将狄九当外人，一拍狄九的肩膀，开心的说道。
游狐离嘴里说很大的地方，其实在狄九看来最多不过二十来个平方而已。如果真的是这样，那也就算了。关键是这个房间里面，还有一个女人。
就是游狐离没有解释，狄九也猜到这应该就是游狐离的女朋友。看起来长相还不错，身材也还好。
“玲儿，这就是我最好的兄弟狄子默，不，现在他改名狄九了。”
说完，游狐离还有些得意的看着狄九道，“小九，我女朋友藤玲儿，才搬来没多久。”
藤玲儿没有游狐离对狄九的这种热情，她看了看狄九背着的包有些不敢确定的看着游狐离说道，“你不是说要他住在这里吧？”
“是啊，这个地方大的很，中间用东西隔一下……”
狄九不等游狐离将话说完，就主动说道，“狐狸，来这里主要是看看你，一会就走。”
听到狄九的话，藤玲儿的脸色好看了一些。
游狐离看出来了藤玲儿的态度，脸色一沉，还没等他说话，他的手机就响了起来。游狐离忍住了发作，接通电话，第一句话就说道，“胡哥，对不起啊，今天我有事没有去上班，我以后不能去药堂上班了……是的，我想去洛大碰碰运气……好的，谢谢，谢谢。”

挂了电话后，游狐离吸了口气，看着藤玲儿眼神有些严厉。
狄九猜得到游狐离要说什么，他可不想因为自己游狐离和藤玲儿闹僵。在他看来，应该是游狐离追求的藤玲儿。估计游狐离追求藤玲儿花了不少精力，别因为他将对方分开了。
拦在游狐离前面，狄九呵呵一笑说道，“狐狸，你之前是在药堂上班?”
“是啊，你不是去过潭杏堂吗，我一直在那里做啊，原来是打打杂，还能学点东西。现在潭杏堂关门了，我其实就是一个看门的而已。”游狐离说道。
“那为什么辞职啊？”狄九再问道。
听到狄九的询问，游狐离精神就是一震，眼睛有些发光的说道，“阿九，你知道仙女星要对所有的人开放了吗？不久之后任何人都有资格去仙女星，我无权无势，进入仙女星唯一的途径就是进入洛大新开的武学院。潭杏堂的潭月玥，就是潭老爷子的孙女，她去了燕大武学系，连潭杏堂都被她放弃了。”
说到这里游狐离压低了声音，“你应该听说仙女星发现了许多珍稀药材和顶级矿物吧？我还听说地球联盟在仙女星上发现了修仙秘法，你知道为什么全球所所有的大学开设武学都必须联盟承认吗？因为联盟在承认后，会将这修仙秘法交给开设武学系的大学，否则你以为大家进入武学系后学什么？”
狄九心里暗笑，他可不相信什么修仙秘法。最多不过是一些武学功法而已，仙女星上能发现这些，可见仙女星也是类似亚伦大陆这样的一个星球，不知道怎么出现在了地球旁边。
对这种武学功法，狄九并不在意。他狄家七刀就是济国最顶级的武学功法，现在狄氏七刀就在他的背包里面，他哪里需要去别的地方寻找？
“你说的是不错，不过我听说洛大武学系非常难进的，就算是有钱也进不去，你去了也是白搭啊，反而平白丢了一个工作。”狄九很不明白游狐离有什么信心能进入洛大武学系。
游狐离脸上的狂热消退了许多，叹了口气说道，“阿九，我虽然没有机会进入上流社会，我眼光还是有的。我可以肯定，在将来仙女星会全面开放，再也不需要武学系学生资格，而且仙女星很有可能会成为地球人类迁移的地方。到了那个时候，我们去了估计连汤也无法喝上一口了，好东西都被别人搜刮走了，我们去了只能建设新地球而已。这还算是好的，差的是我们连去建设的机会都没。
我现在去洛大武学院的机会很渺茫，毕竟还是有机会的。只要我进入洛大，哪怕是在洛大食堂，甚至是洛大的门卫处做做事情，终究可以第一时间获得洛大武学院的一些消息，万一被我抓到机会进去了呢？要知道，我还有初级厨师资格证的。”
游狐离的话让狄九有些惭愧，在济国，他狄家就是一人之下万人之上的存在。而这种条件，他狄九在遭受打击后，每天混吃等死，从未有过和游狐离这样的抱负。人无远虑必有近忧，这句话果然是没有错误。
如今他狄家九族被灭，他自己更是逃出了亚伦大陆。或者说，如果不是因为那灰色小石块引来了一道金色闪电，这个世界早就没有他狄九了。
“阿九，我知道你不看好我……”
狄九拍了拍了拍游狐离的肩膀，“狐狸，我不但看好你，还知道你不用去做什么烧饭的也不用去做门卫，你马上就可以进入武学系。”
“啊……”游狐离有些讶异的看着狄九，他不明白狄九的这话是什么意思。
狄九从背包里面抽出一张蓝色的卡片说道，“这是进入洛大武学院的报名证明，你只要用这个就可以直接进入洛大武学院。”
游狐离一把抓过狄九递给他的武学系证明，将其举起对着光看了一下，随即就不敢相信的震撼问道，“阿九，你怎么会有这种东西，这东西我听说过，你的这张肯定是真货。真货只要对着光，就能看见一个悬浮的仙女星球。”
“你不用问我是从哪里那的，你直接拿去报名吧。”狄九止住了游狐离的话，“不要问我为什么不需要，我目前对这个不感兴趣，将来你发达了不要忘了我就行。”

“可是，可是……”游狐离完全不知道自己应该说什么，这是他梦寐以求的消息，但要让他剥夺狄九的资格去洛大武学院，这根本就不是他想要的。况且这一张报名资格，价格根本就无法估量。
狄九一笑，“不用可是了，你倒是可以帮我一个忙。我最近在学医，那个潭杏堂你不去了，能不能介绍我去一下。”
（今天的更新就到这里，朋友们晚安！）
content_en:
(Thanks to Jiangnan V Shinhwa for the million reward, adding a silver leader to the ninth place in the world)
Di Jiu did not return to his original residence. Not only was the house rented, but he also did not want to get entangled with Di Ziheng from the Di family. Di's Pharmaceuticals sounded awesome, but Di Jiu really didn't take it seriously. What's more, he knew very well that he had nothing to do with Di Wencheng.
Carrying a bag and walking in the bustling Luojin again, Di Jiu's mind was full of where should he go now?
He didn't know how long he had been walking or thinking about it, but suddenly he remembered a phone number in his mind. It seemed that he always called this number every time he needed help in his previous life.
A slightly tired male voice answered the call. When the other party heard Di Jiu's voice, he immediately shouted in surprise, "Zimo, where are you? Why haven't I heard from you in more than a year?"
A familiar name popped up, You Huli, what a strange name. It was obvious that the relationship between You Huli and Di Jiu was extraordinary. After eagerly asking Di Jiu to wait on the phone, he hung up the phone in a hurry.
Di Jiu didn't wait long. In just half an hour, a taxi stopped in front of him.
What got out of the car was a short and fat young man. The young man had an average appearance, his hair was a little messy, and he had a sincere happiness on his face. As soon as Di Jiu saw it, he knew that this young man was You Huli.
"Zimo, where have you been this year? Why didn't you give me a call?" You Huli shouted loudly before he could reach him.
"I went out to relax, but when I came back I didn't even have a place to live. Also, I changed my name to Di Jiu." Di Jiu said.
"Why don't you change your name? Let's go to the place where I live. It's a big place." You Gu didn't regard Di Jiu as an outsider at all. He patted Di Jiu on the shoulder and said happily.
You Huli said it was a big place, but in Di Jiu's opinion, it was only about twenty square meters at most. If that's really the case, then forget it. The key is that there is a woman in this room.
Even though You Huli didn't explain, Di Jiu also guessed that this was You Huli's girlfriend. He looks pretty good and has a good figure.
"Ling'er, this is my best brother Di Zimo. No, his name has been changed to Di Jiu now."
After saying that, You Huli looked at Di Jiu with some pride and said, "Xiao Jiu, my girlfriend Teng Ling'er just moved here not long ago."
Teng Ling'er didn't have the same enthusiasm as You Huli for Di Jiu. She looked at the bag Di Jiu was carrying and looked at You Huli with some uncertainty and said, "You didn't say you wanted him to live here, right?"
"Yes, this place is very big, and there are things in the middle to separate it..."
Di Jiu didn't wait for You Huli to finish what he said, and took the initiative to say, "Fox, I came here mainly to see you, and I'll be leaving soon."
After hearing Di Jiu's words, Teng Linger's face looked better.
You Huli saw Teng Ling'er's attitude and his face darkened. Before he could speak, his cell phone rang. You Huli resisted the attack, answered the phone, and said the first thing he said, "Brother Hu, I'm sorry, I have something to do and I didn't go to work today. I can't go to the medicine hall to work in the future... Yes, I want to go to Luo University to try my luck... Okay, thank you, thank you."
After hanging up the phone, You Huli took a breath and looked at Teng Linger with a stern look.
Di Jiu could guess what You Huli was going to say, and he didn't want to get into trouble with Teng Linger because of him. In his opinion, it should be Teng Linger who You Huli is pursuing. You Huli probably spent a lot of energy pursuing Teng Ling'er, so don't separate him because of him.
Stopping in front of You Huli, Di Jiu chuckled and said, "Fox, you used to work in a medicine hall?"
"Yeah, haven't you been to Tanxingtang? I've been working there. It used to be a side job and I could learn something. Now that Tanxingtang is closed, I'm actually just a janitor." You Huli said.
"Then why did you resign?" Di Jiu asked again.
Hearing Di Jiu's inquiry, You Huli was shocked, and said with bright eyes, "Ajiu, do you know that Fairy Star will be open to everyone? Soon anyone will be eligible to go to Fairy Star. I have no power. The only way to enter Fairy Star is to enter the newly opened martial arts academy of Luo University. Tan Yueyue of Tanxingtang is the granddaughter of Mr. Tan. She went to the martial arts department of Yan University, and even Tanxingtang was abandoned by her."
At this point, You Huli lowered his voice, "You should have heard that many rare medicinal materials and top-grade minerals were discovered on Andromeda, right? I also heard that the Earth Alliance discovered the secret method of cultivating immortality on Andromeda. Do you know why all the universities in the world that offer martial arts must recognize it? Because after the alliance recognizes it, it will hand over the secret method of cultivating immortality to the university that opens the martial arts department. Otherwise, what do you think everyone will learn after entering the martial arts department?"
Di Jiu secretly laughed in his heart, he didn't believe in any secret method of cultivating immortals. At most, they are just some martial arts skills. These can be found on Andromeda. It can be seen that Andromeda is also a planet similar to Aaron's Continent. It doesn't know how it appeared next to the earth.
Di Jiu didn't care about this kind of martial arts technique. His Seven Swordsmen of the Di family are the top martial arts skills in Jiguo. Now that the Seven Swordsmen of the Di family are in his backpack, where does he need to look elsewhere?
"What you said is true, but I heard that it is very difficult to get into the Martial Arts Department of Luo University. Even if you have money, you can't get in. It will be in vain if you go there. Instead, you will lose a job." Di Jiu didn't understand what confidence You Huli had in being able to enter the Martial Arts Department of Luo University.
The enthusiasm on You Huli's face faded a lot, and he sighed and said, "Ajiu, although I have no chance to enter the upper class, I still have a good vision. I can be sure that in the future, Fairy Star will be fully open, and there will no longer be a need for martial arts student qualifications, and Fairy Star is very promising. It may become a place where human beings migrate. By that time, we will not even be able to take a sip of soup. All the good things will be looted by others. We will only be able to build a new earth. The bad thing is that we will not even have a chance to build it.
My chances of going to Luo Dawu Academy are very slim now, but there is still a chance after all. As long as I enter Luo University, even if I am working in the cafeteria of Luo University or even at the gatekeeper of Luo University, I will be able to get some news about Luo Da Wu Academy as soon as possible. What if I get the opportunity to go in? You know, I still have a junior chef qualification certificate. "
You Huli's words made Di Jiu feel a little ashamed. In Jiguo, his Di family was one person below ten thousand people. Under such conditions, Di Jiu, after suffering a blow, ate and waited for death every day. He had never had such ambitions as You Huli. If a person has no long-term worries, he must have immediate worries. This sentence is indeed correct.
Now that his nine Di family clans have been wiped out, he himself has escaped from the Allen Continent. In other words, if it weren't for the golden lightning that was attracted by the small gray stone, Di Jiu would have been gone in this world for a long time.
"Ajiu, I know you don't think highly of me..."
Di Jiu patted You Huli on the shoulder, "Fox, not only do I think highly of you, but I also know that you don't have to be a cook or a janitor. You can enter the martial arts department right away."
"Ah..." You Huli looked at Di Jiu in surprise. He didn't understand what Di Jiu meant by this.
Di Jiu pulled out a blue card from his backpack and said, "This is the registration certificate for entering Luo Dawu Academy. You can directly enter Luo Dawu Academy with this."
You Huli grabbed the martial arts certificate handed to him by Di Jiu, raised it up to the light and looked at it, and then asked in disbelief, "Ah Jiu, how come you have such a thing? I have heard of this thing, and yours must be genuine. As long as the genuine thing is held up to the light, you can see a floatingFairy planet. "
"You don't need to ask me where I got it from, just take it and sign up. Di Jiu stopped You Huli's words and said, "Don't ask me why I don't need it. I'm not interested in this at the moment. Just don't forget me when you get rich in the future." "
"But, but..." You Huli didn't know what he should say at all. This was the news he had dreamed of, but for him to deprive Di Jiu of his qualifications to go to Luo Dawu Academy was not what he wanted at all. Moreover, the price of this registration qualification is simply immeasurable.
Di Jiu smiled and said, "No, you can do me a favor. I'm currently studying medicine. If you don't want to go to Tanxingtang, can you introduce me to it? "
(That’s it for today’s update, good night, friends!)
